items: A new kind of area for the high glaciers' island, the icefall: glacier ice and old snow, cairns and leaning standing stones, stunted pines, rowan and dwarf birch in the lee of the rocks

The snow leopard, a new creature for it: a long, low, pale smoky cat with an enormously long, thick ringed tail, that leaps on you from afar; its legend is the elder of the snow leopards, its tail wrapped round it like a scarf, and its gift is Ghost of the peaks (a longer blink, and sharper turns in the treetops)
